minimum_evidence: official order identifies private/nonfederal status or separates access authority from internal governance
allowed_statement: State the legal or governance boundary exactly at the regime level
forbidden_inference: Do not infer political independence, command control, affiliation, funding or immunity

target_role: private organization class or raw named operation
minimum_evidence: official installation order identifies authority, object and scope of permission
allowed_statement: Authority may permit or withdraw operation on the installation
forbidden_inference: Do not call the command a parent organization, funder, owner or coordinator of private fundraising/personnel

minimum_evidence: official order identifies administrator and function
allowed_statement: State who processes, monitors, coordinates or audits compliance
forbidden_inference: Monitoring is not governance_control, organizational affiliation, sponsorship or proof of a specific audit

unit_of_observation: one required document class or submission cycle
minimum_evidence: official order identifies required record, recipient/file and timing where available
allowed_statement: State which records must be submitted or maintained under the rule
forbidden_inference: Do not claim a named file exists, is complete, is public or was obtained

minimum_evidence: official order identifies trigger, sanction and authority or program mechanism
allowed_statement: State probation, suspension and revocation over installation operation, and preserve any express rule wording such as fourth-occurrence 'Dissolution of the PO'
forbidden_inference: Do not reduce express dissolution wording to operating-status revocation; do not infer ownership, internal control, actual dissolution or proved legal-entity extinction outside the installation regime

minimum_evidence: official order distinguishes continuous license or event-level facility approval
allowed_statement: State the required permission instrument and whether it is continuous or event-specific
forbidden_inference: Do not infer a named room, lease, rent, free use, subsidy or permanent access

minimum_evidence: official order identifies costs, reimbursement/fee rule or explicit condition/prohibition
allowed_statement: State that support is conditional, reimbursable, normally charged or prohibited as the clause provides
forbidden_inference: Do not generate an actual money/service edge without actor-specific transaction evidence; do not call it subsidy or grant

minimum_evidence: official order expressly permits a category or named operation to conduct continuing resale
allowed_statement: State that the operation falls within a rule-defined resale exception for the document period
forbidden_inference: Do not infer funding, monopoly, free space, endorsement, revenue amount, current continuity or political function

minimum_evidence: official order assigns liability to PO/members or rejects government assumption
allowed_statement: State the generic allocation of responsibility in the governing rule
forbidden_inference: Do not decide a named person's liability, actual debt, government funding or absence of all lawful support
